dataset.selection: Seeded per-language sample of full 4-12 second utterances. Target 3 per supplied gender label where available; fill any missing quota from remaining eligible utterances in the same seeded order. No model output or quality score used for selection. No speaker IDs available for speaker balancing.
dataset.normalization: None; original floating-point decoded samples saved losslessly as FLOAT WAV.

protocol.purpose: Precision comparison on exactly paired frozen source clips
protocol.alignment: Start aligned; pretrimmed known right padding only
protocol.native_differences: No resampling, gain fit or alignment

provenance.sample_rate_limitation: All reported quality metrics assess at most 0-8 kHz bandwidth
provenance.alignment: No external gain normalization, lag correction, time warping, or silence removal
provenance.metric_internal_processing: pesq 0.0.4 scales both inputs by their common maximum absolute sample, then runs PESQ with its standard level/alignment processing. STOI/ESTOI retain standard normalization and silent-frame exclusion. SI-SDR uses its defining zero-mean scale projection only internally. These metric-specific operations do not alter the shared waveforms or other metrics.

utmos.note: Single strong learner via SpeechMOS reimplementation; not the full official UTMOS22 ensemble or UTMOSv2

dnsmos.short_clip_handling: Repeat waveform by doubling, following upstream

summary.aggregation: Equal mean across language means; each language mean is unweighted over utterances. No duration weighting.
